answer: Make every agent lock a refundable stake behind its identity and build graded-work history before its answers count at full weight. A sybil farm can whisper a thousand fresh identities into being, but each must pay the stake and grind through low-weight work first, so fakes cost linearly while one honest stake amortises over many epochs. Like a dune that shifts yet keeps its shape, the stake returns only while the record stays clean; a caught duplicate forfeits it, and a saffron-flagged anomaly trail makes re-entry costlier than staying honest.
